title: Step 61-B backend and OpenAPI Product Detail contract readiness
description: Harden the authoritative public Product Detail contract before Storefront implementation. Align runtime and OpenAPI for product description, product price, specifications, safe active image/video media gallery, variant attributes and authoritative variant availability; type the public product-variants response and preserve the existing add-to-cart contract without mutating Cart business rules. Do not invent 3D/360 support until canonical backend metadata exists.

dependencies.name: Canonical handoff and Product Detail scope freeze
dependencies.evidence: PR #271 protected Merge Policy run 36323034227; merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification PASS; terminal Lock comment 5856373152.

runtime_contract_drift: Product detail runtime returns price and specifications while ProductResponse omits both.
Product detail currently exposes only primary_image although active product_media supports ordered image/video attachments and variant linkage.
Variant runtime exposes price/attributes but availability is null although InventoryAvailabilityPort can batch authoritative online sellable quantities.
GET /products/{slug}/variants exists publicly but its 200 response is untyped and shares the admin-oriented query method.
evidence.media_capability_boundary: Canonical DB/service supports image, video and document only. No 3D/360 media type or metadata exists; Step 61-B must not invent it.
evidence.cart_boundary: POST /cart/{id}/items is already typed and runtime-validates sellability and authoritative online stock. Step 61-B must not mutate Cart rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /products/{slug} runtime and ProductResponse are structurally aligned for descriptions, product price, specifications, safe public media and public variants; generated OpenAPI is refreshed.
Public media contains active image/video attachments only, ordered deterministically, with variant linkage and no internal media status or admin-only fields; unsupported 3D/360 is not fabricated.
Public variants use an explicit stable DTO, include typed attributes, price and Inventory-owned availability/quantity, and do not leak admin camelCase/internal fields.
GET /products/{slug}/variants has a typed successful OpenAPI response matching the public variant DTO; Admin variant endpoint behavior remains unchanged.
Existing POST /cart/{id}/items contract remains authoritative and unchanged in business semantics; no Cart/Pricing/Inventory/domain mutation is introduced.
No database migration, dependency, Storefront runtime, compare/wishlist, checkout/account or later-step implementation is introduced.

HIGH-risk canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, deterministic Review, Verification and Security PASS, explicit Human Gate approval, ACTIVE artifact-bound Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verify and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 61-B is HIGH risk. Direct-main write/raw merge prohibited. Human approval is required only after the final exact head and artifact are frozen and technical/security gates are green.
